description: List AI crawlers from the registry, optionally filtered by operator (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), purpose (training, search-index, user-triggered, search-and-training, other), or status (active, retired, renamed). Use it to compare how operators split training from search agents, or to find every training crawler before writing robots.txt rules. Results are paginated.

limit.description: Maximum records to return in this call.

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip. Use next_offset to page forward.

operator.description: Limit to one operator, matched exactly but case-insensitively, for example 'OpenAI'.

query.description: Free-text search over token, operator, and notes.

name: list_crawlers

has_more.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass as 'offset' in the next call to continue paging. Null when has_more is false.

results.description: Matching crawler records (summary fields; call lookup_crawler for the full record).

total_count.description: Total number of matches across all pages.

truncated.description: True when results were shortened to fit the 50 KB output cap. Use the paginated REST API for the full set.

title: List AI crawlers in the registry
